verses.text: <pb/><t>Ku yi tāfi saboda farin ciki,</t> <t>Ya ku jama'a duka!</t> <t>Ku raira waƙoƙi da karfi, ku yabi Allah!</t>
<t>A ji tsoron Ubangiji Mai Iko Dukka,</t> <t>Shi babban Sarki ne, ya mallaki dukan duniya.</t>
<t>Ya ba mu nasara a bisa jama'o'i,</t> <t>Ya sa muka yi mulkin al'ummai,</t>
<t>Ya zaɓar mana ƙasar da muke zaune,</t> <t>Wadda take mallaka ce ta fāriya, ta jama'arsa</t> <t>Wadda yake ƙauna. <pb/></t>
<t>Allah ya hau kan kursiyinsa!</t> <t>Aka yi ta sowa ta murna, ana ta busa ƙahoni,</t> <t>Lokacin da Ubangiji yake hawa!</t>
<t>Ku raira yabbai ga Allah,</t> <t>Ku raira yabbai ga sarkinmu!</t>
<t>Allah sarki ne na duniya duka,</t> <t>Ku yabe shi da waƙoƙi! <pb/></t>
<t>Allah yana zaune kan kursiyinsa mai tsarki,</t> <t>Yana mulkin al'ummai,</t>
<t>Masu mulkin al'ummai suka tattaru</t> <t>Tare da jama'ar Allah na Ibrahim.</t> <t>Allah shi ne garkuwar jarumawa,</t> <t>Yana mulkin duka!</t>
